description: This file provides export functionalities for notes in various formats (txt, pdf, md, html) within the Notesnook project, including functions for exporting individual notes, bulk exporting, creating zip archives, and handling file system operations on mobile platforms.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Determines and creates the export directory path based on platform and type.

methods.name: unlockVaultForNoteExport
methods.description: Unlocks the vault for exporting notes, prompting user if necessary.

methods.name: copyFileAsync
methods.description: Copies a file asynchronously from source to destination.

methods.name: resolveFileFunctions
methods.description: Prepares directory and file writing functions for exporting notes in specified format.

methods.name: exportNoteToFile
methods.description: Exports a single note to a file in specified format, handling PDF conversion if needed.

methods.name: exportAttachmentToFile
methods.description: Exports an attachment by downloading and moving it to cache folder.

methods.name: bulkExport
methods.description: Exports multiple notes and attachments in bulk, creating a zip archive.

methods.name: exportNote
methods.description: Exports a single note, including attachments, to specified format or zip archive.

methods.name: createZip
methods.description: Creates a zip archive of exported files.

methods.name: createFile
methods.description: Creates a single exported file, handling platform-specific file creation and naming.
